about.bio: I'm a second-year B.Tech student at IIT Guwahati exploring web development through hands-on projects. I enjoy creating interactive applications that solve real problems, from algorithm visualizers to circuit analyzers. Currently learning modern web technologies while balancing academics and contributing to institute web projects.

education.degree: B.Tech in Electronics and Communication Engineering

projects.title: P.A.R.K.E.R
projects.description:
Architected a 4-layer persistent memory system (profile, facts, projects, episodic) backed by PostgreSQL + pgvec
tor, with importance-tiered retrieval and automatic archival of stale entries; memory stored as structured JSON
extracted by an LLM — raw transcripts never persisted.– Built a 5-level temporal rollup pipeline (chat → day → week → month → year) on ISO calendar boundaries,
running on background threads with per-namespace write locks, orchestrated by a LangGraph state machine with
a trigger gate that skips retrieval on casual messages to keep latency near zero.

projects.title: B.E.N
projects.description: BEN (Browser Execution Network) is a multi-agent AI system that autonomously completes browser-based tasks. It uses a planner → executor → responder pipeline built on LangGraph, where the planner breaks tasks into steps, browser-use executes them via a real browser, and the responder summarizes the outcome. Supports Gemini, OpenAI, and OpenRouter as LLM backends.

projects.title: Huffman_Text_Compressor
projects.description:
Implemented a lossless file compressor in C++17 using Huffman Coding with min-heap tree construction and
bit-level encoding/packing into a custom binary format.– Achieved ∼44% compression on a 100 MB text file; built full decompression pipeline with exact byte-for-byte
recovery and explicit padding handling for bit-stream alignment.

projects.title: OJSystem
projects.description:
Built a terminal-based online judge in C++17 + PostgreSQL via libpqxx, supporting problem browsing, per-test
case verdicts, and SHA-256 hash-based duplicate detection on submissions.– Engineered a sandboxed execution pipeline using fork(), exec(), and setrlimit() to enforce CPU (RLIMIT_CPU)
and memory (RLIMIT_AS) limits; detects SIGSEGV/SIGABRT and captures g++ stderr for CE verdicts.– Implemented a producer–consumer judge queue using threads and mutexes; supports strict, float epsilon, and
custom checker output validation modes

projects.title: GitLite
projects.description:
Built a fully functional version control system in C++17 from scratch, implementing content-addressable blob
storage and a commit DAG using SHA-256 hashing — mirroring Git’s internal object model.– Designed branching and HEAD as symbolic references with parent-link traversal for commit history, replicating
real-world VCS pointer semantics without any external library.– Developed an LCS-based diff algorithm for line-level change detection and staging index tracking across staged,
modified, and untracked file states
